title: The Paris Funds! Mr Fox! Kitty O’Shea!
html_source:
“Parnell was accused of misappropriating some party funds; he used the pseudonym of Mr. Fox in his adulterous liaison with Mrs. Katherine O'Shea.”

(Courtesy of Grand Valley State University)

anchor.text: The Paris Funds! Mr Fox! Kitty O'Shea!
anchor.prefix: d lady, and a drunken old harridan she was surely, that paid all her attention to me. She kept dancing along beside me in the mud bawling and screaming into my face: Priesthunter!
anchor.suffix:
—And what did you do, John? asked Mr Dedalus.

 —I let her bawl away, said Mr Casey. It was a cold day and to keep up my heart I had (saving your presence, ma’am) a quid of Tull
